body: Hi there! Thanks for the report. I've queued this for a reproduction check on Wails v3. We'll keep this open while we investigate.

Hi there! I reproduced this on Windows. A fix is queued. Thanks!

<details>
<summary>Test evidence</summary>

Tested master ([pinned source](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/commit/61edfcc36710bc6b25d1d0d644b94e187c5be105)). Each VM started from its clean test snapshot and ran offline.

Trigger: A staged update plus a parent process that does not exit within the wait window (reported as >30 s, e.g. a slow OnShutdown). runHelperSwap's injected processWaiter is driven into its timeout branch (parentPID>0 and wait returns an error), which the source shows leading to `return 17` before clearHelperEnv, backup, replaceTarget or launch.

Expected: When the parent-exit wait times out and the target has not been replaced (still original content), the helper should still attempt to relaunch the original executable rather than exit with nothing running, or at minimum the report wants relaunch attempts.

**Windows 11 24H2 ARM64 — reproduced**

```text
go test -json -count=1 -timeout=90s -run ^TestWorkflowReproHelperTimeoutLeavesOriginalRelaunchable$ ./pkg/updater
Microsoft Windows NT 10.0.26100.0
go version go1.27.1 windows/arm64
REPRO_OBSERVATION: exit_code=17 launches=0 target_unchanged=true
REPRO_ASSERTION: parent-timeout abort exit_code=17 launches=0 target_unchanged=true; original intact but nothing was relaunched
```

The failing regression assertion is the evidence; compilation and setup succeeded.

Scope: a Go package test against this pinned version, simulating the reported failure. It does not establish behavior in every release or exercise the GUI. Screenshots are not applicable. 

Revision selection: current public master. Results apply only to the pinned source and OS shown; an inferred version is not attributed to the reporter.

Independent evidence review agreed with these results.

</details>
